verdict.rationale: Slate ships as an official terminal CLI installed via `npm i -g @randomlabs/slate`, and the probe confirms the CLI is documented in the quickstart. First-party docs describe a full TUI workflow: slash commands (`/sessions`, `/workspace`, `/models`, `/bug-report`), `!` shell execution, `@filename` references, hotkeys, and CLI flags such as `--dangerously-skip-permissions`/`--yolo`. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI experience, and any documented non-interactive/headless scripting mode or full flag reference.
